fields.summary_ko.0: NVDA fell over 7% in pre-market trading following reports of possible management change at CEO Jensen Huang, while Wall Street's average target price of $283.83 suggests 63% upside potential.
fields.summary_ko.1: Q3 FY27 earnings (November 17) expected to show EPS $2.47 (up 90% year-over-year) and revenue $108.84B (up 91% year-over-year), but major analysts including Keybanc, Meriucs, and Bernstein have downgraded due to leadership concerns.
